name: modl.ai
shortDescription: AI agents that test an uploaded game build and report bugs.
longDescription: modl.ai's homepage says its agents test a game from an uploaded build, with no engine integration, and write bug reports that include visuals and a severity score. The page did not list a price.
pricingNotes: The homepage did not list a price.
